This is the screenshot of my terminal window. I cannot see any questions or assignments or files inside the directory after i created using mkdir as mentioned. How do i fix this ?

posts.name: Dalyodh Singh
posts.cooked:
se2001 that you created parallel to “README.md” will only for solutions written by you
for Question:
you need to follow this procedure:

Step1: cd ~ (reach home directory)
Step2: cd /opt/se2001
Step3: ls
you will see all questions like this

image1920×683 144 KB

Step4: batcat (questionname)
use above command with question name to read that question
